content.value_statement: New projects need a clear SpecDD bootstrap before specification work begins. This skill guides Codex, Claude, and Claude Code through CLI setup, update checks, and initial scope reporting.
actual_capabilities: Checks for existing SpecDD bootstrap files and .sdd contracts before setup.
Uses the specdd-cli skill and SpecDD CLI for requested initialization or framework updates.
Reports when CLI availability blocks setup or update work.
Reads the active bootstrap chain before proposing or creating local specs after setup.
Proposes a small initial specification shape based on repository boundaries.
Creates .sdd files only after explicit user approval.
limitations: Requires the SpecDD CLI or a reachable specdd-cli skill for setup and updates.
Does not manually copy or edit SpecDD bootstrap framework files.
Does not replace specdd-author for ongoing specification writing.
Avoids implementation changes unless the user requests that work.

use_cases.title: Bootstrap a New Repository
use_cases.description: Add SpecDD framework files through the CLI and report the initial adoption scope.

use_cases.title: Update Framework Files
use_cases.description: Refresh existing SpecDD bootstrap files through the supported CLI workflow.

use_cases.title: Plan Initial Specifications
use_cases.description: Review repository boundaries and propose a small root specification before authoring child specs.

prompt_templates.title: Add SpecDD
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a repository without an existing bootstrap.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add SpecDD to this repository. Check whether it is already bootstrapped, use the SpecDD CLI if needed, and report what changed.

prompt_templates.title: Update Bootstrap
prompt_templates.scenario: Refresh framework files in an existing SpecDD project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the SpecDD framework files in this repository. Use the CLI path, do not edit bootstrap files manually, and summarize remaining setup.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Adoption Scope
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare initial specs before writing local authority files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this repository for initial SpecDD boundaries. Propose the smallest useful root spec and child specs before creating any files.

prompt_templates.title: Adopt With Constraints
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced adoption in a mature repository with limited inspection.
prompt_templates.prompt: Adopt SpecDD for this mature repository. Limit inspection to top-level structure, manifests, docs, tests, and entry points. Create .sdd files only after approval.

output_examples.input: Add SpecDD to this repository and tell me what changed.
output_examples.output: The repository was not bootstrapped. CLI initialization completed, one root specification was proposed, and no implementation files changed.

output_examples.input: This project already uses SpecDD. Update the framework files only.
output_examples.output: The repository was already bootstrapped. The framework update ran through the CLI, and no local specs were modified.

output_examples.input: Review this repository and suggest the first SpecDD scope.
output_examples.output: The best starting point is a root project specification. It should cover ownership, references, constraints, and major entry points.

best_practices: Confirm whether setup, update, or authoring is the requested task before starting.
Use the SpecDD CLI for framework files and keep manual edits limited to approved local specs.
Report bootstrap status, adoption scope, created specs, and any blocked setup steps.
anti_patterns: Manually copying bootstrap framework files instead of using the CLI.
Creating .sdd files before the user approves the adoption scope.
Changing implementation code during adoption without an explicit user request.

faq.question: Does this skill install SpecDD manually?
faq.answer: No. It routes setup and framework updates through the SpecDD CLI path.

faq.question: Can it create .sdd files?
faq.answer: Yes, but only when the user requests or approves the adoption scope.

faq.question: What happens if the CLI is missing?
faq.answer: The skill reports that setup or update is blocked until the CLI is available.

faq.question: Will it edit implementation code?
faq.answer: No. It avoids implementation changes unless the user explicitly requests them.

faq.question: When should I use specdd-author instead?
faq.answer: Use specdd-author after bootstrap when the task is normal SpecDD authoring.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is described for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
